subject: Social Media
title: Algorithmic Lobbying
description: A fast breakdown of Algorithmic Lobbying for builders.

hook.text: Tech companies spend more on lobbying than oil or pharma. Google spent $13 million in one quarter alone.

buildup.text: Lobbying shapes which bills survive. Platform companies fight regulation on privacy, antitrust, and child safety.

discovery.text: The revolving door spins fast. Ex-regulators join tech firms. Ex-tech employees write regulations. Lines blur.

twist.text: Platforms also lobby through their products. Showing users 'this law threatens your privacy' is political messaging.

climax.text: When the platform is both the message and the medium, lobbying becomes invisible—woven into the feed itself.

punchline.text: The biggest lobbyist owns the conversation itself.

quiz.question: How do platforms uniquely lobby beyond traditional spending?
options: By showing political messages through their own products
